details:
## Problem

Currently, group instances have a critical limitation: even as the instance creator/host or group creator, you cannot invite people who are not members of the group. This creates friction for event organizers and communities who need to bring in temporary guests (DJs, performers, collaborators) without granting them permanent group membership.

## Current Pain Points

**1. Can't invite existing group members reliably**

Even when someone is already in the group, the invite button is often greyed out or non-functional in group instances. The client doesn't properly check permissions server-side before showing UI options.

**2. No guest invites for non-members**

To bring someone outside the group to a group instance, hosts must:

- Invite them to the group

- Wait for them to join (can take up to 5 minutes for the instance list to update)

- Hope they find the instance

- Remember to remove them afterward

This is error-prone. Users with **"Manage Group Members"** permission frequently forget to remove temporary guests, leading to:

- Group bloat (forgotten to remove)

- People taking offense at being removed

- Group instance not appearing in the list for long periods

**3. Group+ doesn't solve this**

Group+ allows *anyone* to join freely, which defeats the purpose of controlled events where hosts want to curate attendance. What organizers need is **Invite+ for groups** - members join freely, non-members request entry.

## Use Cases

- **DJs/performers** guesting for a group event who don't want permanent group membership

- **One-night guests** for special events

- **Cross-community collaborations** where permanent membership isn't appropriate

- **Large communities** where manual group management doesn't scale

- **Events needing setup time** before opening to general members

## Proposed Solutions

### Solution 1: Instance-Level Whitelist with "Invite Guests" Permission

Add a new permission **"Invite Guests to Instance"** for group roles. Hosts (or roles with this permission) can invite non-group-members directly to a specific instance. The invited user gets whitelisted for that instance ID only. No group membership required, no cleanup needed afterward.

### Solution 2: Role-Based Invite+ for Groups

Allow configuring group instances where certain roles (e.g., **Staff**) can join freely, but other roles must request to join.

Example: Event **Staff** get instant access, regular **Members** request entry, this prevents instance flooding during setup.

### Solution 3: Temporary Group Membership (Time-Limited Invites)

Similar to a subscription model. Invite users to the group with an `until` date. After expiration, access is automatically revoked. No manual cleanup needed.

### Solution 4: Group: Invite+ Instance Type

New instance type where:

- Group members can join freely

- Friends of members must request an invite

Perfect for close-knit communities to screen friends without making instances fully public.

## Related Requests

- [Group: Invite+](https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/group-invite) (103 votes) — Same core need: screening non-group guests without full public access

- [Allow Group Invite+ Instances](https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/allow-group-invite-instances) (38 votes) — Role-based access: Staff joins freely, others request entry

- [Invite Friends to Group Instances](https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/invite-friends-to-group-instances) (30 votes) — The invite button is broken even for existing group members

- [Group instance visibility toggle](https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/group-instance-visibility-toggle) (8 votes) — Hide instance until Staff are in, then allow invites/joins

- [Group Invite Only and invite+](https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/group-invite-only-and-invite) (8 votes) — Host-controlled guest access for events with capacity limits
title: Allow inviting guests to Group Instances (instance-level whitelist)
